Required: Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 runtime for cosmetic loader
Optional: MetaHuman Creator Core Data and Epic sign-in
Setup: First run asks Play mods or Create mods. Complete Steam installations no longer need manual game-build approval. Prepared downloads set up the cosmetic runtime without Epic, Unreal, Blender or mapping capture. Creator setup discovers tools and guides official installer/sign-in steps.

Validation.Scope: Queued Lua event and native package tests, isolated actual updater transaction and native hair-export diagnostics. Full universal clothing gameplay acceptance and stutter improvement remain pending.

DependencyStatus: ImageSharp 3.1.12 remains pinned with five advisories; bounded static PNG handoff. See DEPENDENCY-STATUS.md.
Note: Beta. Hair export waits for explicit native completion and preserves correlated failure diagnostics. Runtime changes coalesce redundant skin callbacks and avoid detailed idle groom reads. Rebuild an existing hairstyle for the distance-LOD binding recipe. Shared clothing authoring is a preview with strict fit refusal; all-body/all-slot gameplay and friend-PC recovery remain unverified.

AutomaticUpdates.Apply: After normal Studio exit and game/Unreal close
AutomaticUpdates.LegacyRecovery: 0.2.77–0.2.81 installs whose old updater rejects their existing inventory need one complete-ZIP manual update, retaining the original workspace and artwork. Current stock portraits use accepted assets/brand paths.

MetaHumanSetup.ExactSizes: Read selected components in Epic Launcher Options
MetaHumanSetup.HardwareGuidance: Epic recommendations; not minimums or installation blockers
MetaHumanSetup.SkinDetails: Paused; no extension or local C++ build required

Workflow.Entry: My characters | My clothes | Downloads | Create | Settings
Workflow.Player: Browse mods -> Subscribe -> matching wearer -> My characters -> Choose an outfit -> Play
Workflow.Texture: My characters -> player -> Edit this game character (stock) or Customize (custom) -> Edit textures -> item -> Export model & textures -> Artwork -> Import texture set -> Build & launch game
Workflow.Clothing: Create -> Make clothes -> slot -> edit and save on shared master rig -> Build clothing -> Choose character and test. Existing projects keep their saved working files.
Workflow.Character: Create or continue a MetaHuman draft -> Open in MetaHuman Creator -> edit and save -> Build & launch game -> Studio automatically assembles, adapts the native game rig, fits the starter outfit, binds compatible Creator hair and cooks -> Check Player Select and a match. Blender runs in the background; no manual FBX/part import is required.
Workflow.StockEditing: My characters -> Tyreese, DeShawn or Darnell -> Edit this game character -> textures or meshes. Stock player identity is retained.
Workflow.Fitting: One reusable garment adapted for the selected supported stock or prepared custom body. Geometry/skin/motion checks refuse invalid fits and retain prior outfit. Full all-body/all-slot gameplay acceptance remains in progress; glove finger checks can refuse.
Workflow.Library: Three stock players plus genuinely installed custom avatars. My clothes includes authored projects, subscribed downloads and sealed character wardrobe garments. Same-name saved versions group by wearer and slot; choose latest or earlier versions without deleting sources.
Workflow.Portraits: Model illustrations rather than UV maps. Offline cards do not reproduce unavailable hair grooms, iris shading or native game lighting.
Workflow.NextAction: One primary action per stage. Changed Blender saves or artwork invalidate old build and game confirmations.
Workflow.MissingTextureRecovery: Same item -> Artwork -> Import PNG or Import texture set. Preserve original maps and packed Mask layout.
Workflow.Wardrobe: Wearer -> category -> compatible clothing -> Play with outfit. Texture edits and clothing changes do not require a new character.
Workflow.MasterKit: One native authoring rig with reference items and green body/face references, generated from installed game. Seven slot creation targets; blanks where no verified source garment exists.
Workflow.Publishing: My clothes -> garment -> Submit to gallery -> Google sign-in -> match code -> Rowe approves posting access -> prepare and review -> two confirmations -> Send to Rowe -> green only after receipt
Workflow.CreatorDownloads: Create -> Get editable clothing files -> import, fit and build with creator tools
Workflow.MultiFitPants: My clothes -> pants -> Add another body fit for each intended body -> finish and build each fit -> Build one pants download all fits -> Submit pants with all fits. Subscribe once -> choose character -> matching verified fit selected automatically.

CreatorRequired: Unreal Engine 5.8.3 for character assembly and game asset cooking
Blender for automatic background mesh and game-rig preparation
